hotelDesc.overview:
Experience Luxury and Convenience at New Orient Hotel Da Nang

Welcome to New Orient Hotel Da Nang, a 4.5-star oasis nestled in the heart of Da Nang, Vietnam. With its prime location just 1 km from the city center, this hotel offers the perfect blend of tranquility and accessibility. Step inside and immerse yourself in a world of luxury and comfort. New Orient Hotel Da Nang boasts a total of 99 elegantly appointed rooms, each designed with your utmost comfort in mind. Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, you'll find everything you need for a memorable stay. The hotel was last renovated in 2021, ensuring that all facilities are modern, stylish, and up to date. Check-in is available from 02:00 PM, allowing you to settle in and start your vacation at your own pace. The friendly and attentive staff will be there to welcome you and assist with any requests you may have. When it's time to bid farewell, check-out is until 12:00 PM, giving you plenty of time to savor your last moments in this beautiful city. New Orient Hotel Da Nang was built in 2017, showcasing contemporary architecture and a design that seamlessly blends traditional Vietnamese elements with modern aesthetics. Its strategic location also means that it's only a short 15-minute drive away from the airport, making it an ideal choice for travelers seeking convenience and efficiency. Families traveling with children will appreciate the hotel's child policy. Children between the ages of 6 to 11 can stay free of charge, allowing you to create lasting memories together without any additional costs. Experience the warmth and hospitality of New Orient Hotel Da Nang, where luxury, convenience, and family-friendly services await.

Unwind and Indulge at New Orient Hotel Da Nang's Entertainment Facilities

At New Orient Hotel Da Nang, guests are invited to unwind and indulge in a range of entertainment facilities that are sure to enhance their stay. Whether you're looking to relax or have a fun-filled evening, this hotel has something for everyone. Start your evening off with a visit to the hotel's stylish bar, where you can enjoy a refreshing cocktail or a glass of wine. The bar provides a cozy and sophisticated ambiance, perfect for socializing or simply enjoying a quiet drink. For those who love to dance the night away, New Orient Hotel Da Nang features a vibrant nightclub. With its energetic atmosphere and top-notch music selection, this nightclub is the perfect place to let loose and have a memorable night out. If you're in need of some pampering, the hotel offers a salon and spa where you can indulge in a variety of treatments. From massages to facials, you'll leave feeling rejuvenated and refreshed. For ultimate relaxation, take advantage of the hotel's hot tub, sauna, and steam room. These facilities provide the perfect opportunity to unwind and melt away any stress or tension. If you're in the mood for some outdoor relaxation, the hotel's garden is the ideal spot. Take a leisurely stroll or find a quiet corner to read a book and enjoy the peaceful surroundings. For those who love to sing their hearts out, New Orient Hotel Da Nang also offers karaoke facilities. Gather your friends and showcase your singing talents in a private and entertaining setting. With its wide range of entertainment facilities, New Orient Hotel Da Nang ensures that every guest has a memorable and enjoyable stay. Whether you're seeking relaxation, fun, or a combination of both, this hotel has it all.

Stay Active and Energized at New Orient Hotel Da Nang's Sports Facilities

At New Orient Hotel Da Nang, we understand the importance of staying active and energized during your vacation. That's why we offer a range of top-notch sports facilities to cater to all your fitness needs. Start your day with a refreshing swim in our outdoor pool, surrounded by lush greenery and comfortable loungers. Take a dip and soak up the sun as you enjoy the breathtaking views of the city. If you prefer a more relaxed atmosphere, our poolside bar is just a few steps away, where you can sip on a refreshing cocktail or indulge in a light snack. For those who prefer a workout indoors, our free fitness center is equipped with state-of-the-art equipment to help you stay in shape. Open 24 hours a day, you can fit in a workout whenever it suits your schedule. Whether you're looking to lift weights, do cardio exercises, or engage in a high-intensity interval training session, our fitness center has everything you need to break a sweat. And of course, being located just steps away from the beach, you have the perfect opportunity to engage in water sports or simply enjoy a leisurely stroll along the shore. Feel the sand between your toes and let the ocean breeze invigorate your senses as you take in the beauty of Da Nang's coastline. At New Orient Hotel Da Nang, we believe in providing our guests with the best facilities to ensure a memorable stay. Stay active, rejuvenate your mind and body, and create lasting memories at our exceptional sports facilities.

Convenience Facilities at New Orient Hotel Da Nang

New Orient Hotel Da Nang offers a range of convenient facilities to ensure a comfortable and hassle-free stay for its guests. From the moment you arrive, you'll be greeted by friendly staff who are ready to assist you with any requests or inquiries. The hotel provides a laundry service and dry cleaning facilities, making it easy for guests to keep their clothes fresh and clean throughout their stay. Additionally, the daily housekeeping service ensures that your room is always tidy and well-maintained. For those who prefer to dine in the comfort of their own room, New Orient Hotel Da Nang offers room service, allowing guests to enjoy delicious meals without having to leave their room. Safety deposit boxes are available at the front desk, providing peace of mind for guests who wish to store their valuable belongings securely. The concierge service is also on hand to assist with any travel arrangements or recommendations for local attractions. Stay connected during your stay with the hotel's Wi-Fi in public areas, as well as free Wi-Fi in all rooms. Whether you need to catch up on work emails or simply browse the internet, you can do so effortlessly. For smokers, there is a designated smoking area where you can enjoy a cigarette without inconveniencing others. Lastly, the hotel offers luggage storage for guests who need a secure place to store their belongings before check-in or after check-out. With these convenience facilities, New Orient Hotel Da Nang ensures that guests have everything they need for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

Convenient Transport Facilities at New Orient Hotel Da Nang

At New Orient Hotel Da Nang, we understand the importance of seamless travel experiences for our guests. That's why we offer a range of convenient transport facilities to ensure your stay with us is hassle-free. For those arriving by air, our airport transfer service is available to pick you up and drop you off at Da Nang International Airport. Sit back and relax as our professional drivers take care of your transportation needs. Exploring the city is made easy with our shuttle service, which provides convenient transportation to popular attractions and shopping areas in Da Nang. If you prefer to explore at your own pace, we also offer a car park free of charge, allowing you to conveniently park your vehicle during your stay. To further enhance your travel experience, our hotel provides a taxi service and ticket service. Whether you need a ride to a specific destination or assistance with booking tickets for local attractions, our friendly staff is here to assist you. At New Orient Hotel Da Nang, we strive to make your stay as comfortable and convenient as possible. Take advantage of our comprehensive transport facilities and enjoy a stress-free experience during your time in Da Nang.

Indulge in a Culinary Journey at New Orient Hotel Da Nang

At New Orient Hotel Da Nang, dining is an experience that will delight your taste buds and leave you craving for more. With a range of dining facilities to choose from, you'll never run out of options during your stay. Start your day with a scrumptious breakfast buffet at the hotel's restaurant, where you can savor a variety of delectable dishes from around the world. From freshly baked pastries to a selection of hot and cold items, there's something to please every palate. If you prefer a lighter meal, the continental breakfast is the perfect choice. For a quick caffeine fix or a relaxing afternoon, head to the hotel's cozy coffee shop. Indulge in a cup of aromatic coffee or choose from a selection of teas and refreshing beverages. The coffee shop also offers a range of snacks and light bites to satisfy your cravings. If you prefer to dine in the comfort of your room, the hotel offers convenient room service. Choose from a diverse menu featuring both local and international cuisines, and have your meal delivered right to your doorstep. Whether it's a hearty dinner or a late-night snack, the room service at New Orient Hotel Da Nang has got you covered. For those who enjoy outdoor dining, the hotel provides BBQ facilities where you can grill your favorite meats and vegetables. Gather with friends or family and enjoy a delightful BBQ feast while taking in the scenic views of Da Nang. If you have any special dietary requirements, the hotel also caters to specific needs. With a halal restaurant and a kosher restaurant on-site, guests can enjoy delicious meals prepared according to their dietary preferences. With daily housekeeping, you can rest assured that your dining experience will be accompanied by a clean and well-maintained environment. Additionally, the hotel offers grocery deliveries, ensuring that you have access to fresh ingredients and snacks throughout your stay. At New Orient Hotel Da Nang, dining is not just about satisfying your hunger, but also about creating unforgettable memories. With a wide range of dining facilities and services, your culinary journey here will be nothing short of extraordinary.

Luxurious and Diverse Room Options at New Orient Hotel Da Nang

Discover a range of beautifully appointed rooms at New Orient Hotel Da Nang, crafted to suit every traveler’s preference. Choose from the cozy Deluxe Double City View or the versatile Deluxe Twin City View, each spanning 32 square meters and offering comfortable bedding options. For those seeking extra space and relaxation, the Premier Deluxe rooms provide 35 square meters with the choice of a King or Twin beds, while the Suite Double Room offers a spacious 50 square meters for added comfort. For a touch of elegance, the Loft with Bathtub provides 60 square meters of luxury, perfect for unwinding in style. Travelers looking for more room and amenities can opt for the generous Apartment Double, covering 90 square meters with two King Beds, or the Suite with Balcony for a refined experience. The hotel also offers various options without views, such as the Superior Double or Twin Room and Standard Double or Twin Room, both around 30 square meters. For those who prefer scenic vistas, the Premier Deluxe River View with Balcony and Deluxe Double or Twin Pool View rooms are ideal choices. Booking through Agoda guarantees you the best prices and a seamless, hassle-free experience, making your stay in Da Nang truly memorable.

Discover the Vibrant Neighborhood of Hội Châu in Da Nang

Nestled in the heart of Da Nang, Vietnam, the neighborhood of Hội Châu is a vibrant and bustling area that offers a perfect blend of cultural heritage and modern attractions. With its strategic location along the Han River, Hội Châu is known for its stunning waterfront views and picturesque bridges, making it a popular spot for locals and tourists alike. One of the highlights of Hội Châu is its rich history and cultural significance. The neighborhood is home to several historical landmarks, including the iconic Dragon Bridge, which is not only an architectural marvel but also a symbol of good luck and prosperity. Visitors can witness the awe-inspiring dragon-shaped bridge come to life as it breathes fire and water every weekend night. In addition to its historical charm, Hội Châu also offers a vibrant culinary scene. Food enthusiasts will be delighted by the array of local street food stalls and restaurants serving up mouthwatering Vietnamese delicacies. From savory banh mi sandwiches to flavorful pho and fresh seafood, there is something to satisfy every palate. After indulging in the local cuisine, visitors can take a leisurely stroll along the riverfront promenade, enjoying the cool breeze and admiring the city skyline.

Convenient Transportation Options from the Airport to New Orient Hotel Da Nang

New Orient Hotel Da Nang, located in the vibrant H?i Châu district of Da Nang, Vietnam, offers a variety of convenient transportation options for guests arriving at the nearby airports. The hotel is easily accessible from both Da Nang International Airport and Chu Lai International Airport, ensuring a hassle-free journey to your destination. If you are arriving at Da Nang International Airport, the most convenient way to reach New Orient Hotel Da Nang is by taxi. Taxis are readily available outside the airport terminal, and the journey to the hotel takes approximately 15 minutes, depending on traffic conditions. Alternatively, you can also arrange for a private transfer with the hotel in advance, ensuring a seamless and comfortable journey to your accommodation. For those arriving at Chu Lai International Airport, the easiest way to get to New Orient Hotel Da Nang is by booking a private transfer or arranging for a taxi. The journey from Chu Lai International Airport to the hotel takes approximately 1.5 to 2 hours, depending on traffic conditions. It is recommended to book a transfer in advance to avoid any inconvenience upon arrival. New Orient Hotel Da Nang offers a convenient and accessible location for travelers, with various transportation options available to ensure a smooth and enjoyable journey from the nearby airports. Whether you choose to take a taxi or arrange for a private transfer, you can look forward to a comfortable and convenient arrival at this stylish hotel in the heart of Da Nang.

Explore the Rich Heritage and Modern Wonders near New Orient Hotel Da Nang

Nestled in the heart of Da Nang, New Orient Hotel Da Nang offers easy access to a plethora of landmarks and attractions that showcase the city's rich heritage and modern wonders. Just a short distance away, you'll find the Da Nang Museum of Cham Sculpture, where you can immerse yourself in the ancient Cham civilization through its impressive collection of sculptures and artifacts. For those seeking spiritual enlightenment, the serene Phap Lam Pagoda is a must-visit. Adorned with intricate Buddhist architecture, this sacred site offers a peaceful respite from the bustling city. Additionally, the Da Nang Cathedral, also known as the Rooster Church, is an architectural gem that stands as a testament to the city's French colonial past. For a taste of Da Nang's modern attractions, head over to the Sun World Danang Wonders. This amusement park promises a day of fun and excitement with thrilling rides, entertaining shows, and vibrant street performances. If you're looking for a bird's eye view of Da Nang, take a ride on the iconic Sun Wheel, the tallest Ferris wheel in Vietnam, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the city and its surroundings. History buffs will appreciate the Ho Chi Minh and the Fifth Military Zone Museum, which showcases the life and revolutionary activities of Vietnam's beloved leader, Ho Chi Minh. Meanwhile, the Museum of Sa Huynh & Champa Culture provides a fascinating insight into the ancient Sa Huynh and Champa civilizations through its extensive collection of artifacts. If you're in the mood for some relaxation, the nearby Red Beach offers a tranquil escape with its pristine white sand and crystal-clear waters. Whether you're seeking cultural immersion or thrilling adventures, the surrounding landmarks and attractions near New Orient Hotel Da Nang have something for everyone, making it an ideal base for your Da Nang exploration.

Convenient Public Transport Stations near New Orient Hotel Da Nang

Situated within walking distance, this station provides easy connections to other major cities in Vietnam, making it a convenient option for travelers arriving or departing by train. From here, guests can also take advantage of the local bus services that operate in the area, allowing them to explore Da Nang's attractions and nearby destinations with ease. Another notable public transport station near New Orient Hotel Da Nang is the Da Nang Bus Station. Situated just a short drive away, this station offers a wide network of bus routes that connect various parts of the city. Whether you're planning to visit the iconic Marble Mountains, the beautiful My Khe Beach, or the bustling Han Market, the Da Nang Bus Station provides a convenient and affordable way to reach these popular attractions. With regular bus services and a well-connected network, guests can easily navigate Da Nang's vibrant streets and immerse themselves in the local culture and charm.

A Gastronomic Adventure Awaits

New Orient Hotel Da Nang is surrounded by a plethora of dining options that will satisfy even the most discerning palates. Just a stone's throw away from the hotel, you'll find Pizza 4P's Hoang Van Thu, known for their delectable wood-fired pizzas and cozy atmosphere. For a taste of authentic Vietnamese cuisine, head over to Banh mi - Mi AA - Happy Bread or Tre Viet cuisine, where you can indulge in flavorful banh mi sandwiches and traditional dishes bursting with local flavors. If you're in the mood for a nostalgic dining experience, Khong Gian Xua is the place to be, with its charming decor and mouthwatering Vietnamese specialties. For those craving a juicy steak, Olivia's Prime Steakhouse is a must-visit, offering top-quality cuts cooked to perfection. Limoncello Danang - Pizza & Restaurant is another fantastic option, serving up delicious Italian fare including their signature pizzas. LUK LAK Restaurant is a great choice for those seeking a fusion of Vietnamese and international flavors, while Memory Lounge offers a cozy ambiance and a menu of international delights. If you're looking for a fine dining experience, Red Sky Steakhouse is the place to be, with its elegant setting and exquisite steaks. Lastly, Hue Ngon Restaurant is a must-visit for those wanting to explore the unique flavors of Hue cuisine. With such a diverse range of restaurants just moments away, New Orient Hotel Da Nang is the perfect base for a gastronomic adventure in Da Nang.

Shop 'til you drop at New Orient Hotel Da Nang's surrounding shopping landmarks

Pheva Chocolate is a paradise for chocolate lovers, offering a tempting selection of handmade chocolates and treats. Kitsch Stores is a treasure trove of unique and quirky items, perfect for finding one-of-a-kind souvenirs. Vinh Trung Plaza is a popular shopping mall that houses a wide range of shops, from fashion and beauty to electronics and home decor. Nhat Hoa Silk Co., Ltd specializes in silk products, offering a wide range of beautiful silk garments and accessories. Danang Bazaar is a bustling marketplace where you can find a variety of local products, including handicrafts, textiles, and traditional Vietnamese items. Finally, Da Nang Souvenirs & Cafe is the perfect place to pick up souvenirs to remember your trip, while also enjoying a cup of Vietnamese coffee. With these shopping landmarks just a stone's throw away from New Orient Hotel Da Nang, you'll have plenty of opportunities to indulge in some retail therapy during your stay.
